preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= len(N) <= 18 for N in test_cases)
preconditions.description: Each test case number N has between 1 and 18 digits inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= rank <= factorial(len(N)) // prod(factorial(N.count(str(digit))) for digit in set(N)) for N, rank in zip(test_cases, ranks))
postconditions.description: The rank of each number N is between 1 and the number of permutations of its digits inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(rank == sorted(permutations(N)).index(N) + 1 for N, rank in zip(test_cases, ranks))
postconditions.description: The rank of each number N is its 1-based index in the sorted list of all permutations of its digits.
